name: active fault zone
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 可能发生构造错动的断裂区域。
usage_overview: 在铁路工程分析中，活动断裂带作为可能发生构造错动的地质区域，主要关注其错动引起的隧道、轨道及基础几何变形，以及由此产生的轨道结构响应和车辆—轨道系统动力性能变化。

complete_examples.text: With the rapid development of railway construction, it is inevitable to cross the long active fault zone [1–3].
Whereas, the current widely used track structure, ballastless track, is difficult to repair once damage is caused during its service life in the active fault zone.

P080.title: Response of prefabricated-polyurethane reinforced ballasted track to dislocation in tunnels through active fault zone

contexts.text: 可能发生构造错动、使穿越隧道及轨道变形的地质区域。
